source.title: Junior School Curriculum Design - English - Grade 8
source.notes: KICD's own Google Drive index (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1WmQXD4FTiFrInrCQMu1w-cjmPPaLEvw5/preview, confirmed via WebFetch) shows the official filename as 'English Grade 8 - Revised Oct.pdf', but that Drive file is download-blocked so its text could not be read directly. The document actually read here (via WebFetch's saved-local-copy + Read, full text read verbatim, NOT summarized) is doyenpublishers.com's mirror. Its title page reads 'KENYA INSTITUTE OF CURRICULUM DEVELOPMENT / JUNIOR SCHOOL CURRICULUM DESIGN / ENGLISH / GRADE 8', 'First published 2023 / Revised 2024', ISBN 978-9914-43-805-5, no DRAFT watermark visible in the text read -- this closely matches the official Drive's 'Revised Oct' 2024 designation. Ministry preface signatures (Cabinet Secretary Ezekiel Machogu, PS Belio Kipsang') match the correct 2024-era officials, confirming authenticity and recency. Structure verified against both the front-matter 'Summary of Strands and Sub Strands' table and the full per-theme detail sections (15 themes), which matched exactly. Marked 'high' confidence: full text read verbatim via Read tool, structure internally consistent, provenance signatures correct for the 2024 revision. STRUCTURE NOTE: the design's per-theme body headings consistently label the third sub-strand slot 'Grammar in Use' (matching Grade 9's strand name, used here instead of the front-matter summary table's shorter label 'Grammar' -- both refer to the same strand; 'Grammar in Use' was chosen as this file's strand name since it is the more frequently and consistently used heading in the document body). The 'Reading' strand appears twice per theme (second and fourth sub-strand slots) -- an extensive/general-reading track ('Reading 1' in the summary table) and an intensive class-reader track ('Reading 2' in the summary table, mostly short stories from an anthology plus occasional standalone poems) -- mirroring the same interleaved pattern used in grade-9/english.json. Per the design's own 'Guidelines on the Study of Class Readers' section, the Grade 8 class reader is specified generically as an anthology of short stories (genre only, not a specific fixed title), consistent with Reading 2 sub-strand content referring to 'a short story' / '(Class Reader)' rather than a named book.
